reference.title: Surface titles and agent-friendly JSON in ox session list
reference.summary: Made ox session list actually useful for figuring out what a session was about. The old output — DATE/TIME/USER/TURNS/STATUS/SESSION — was fine for bookkeeping but useless for identification. Each row now carries a second indented line with the session title from meta.json, falling back intelligently to the first real prose sentence of the summary (skipping headings, bullets, and 'Summary generation failed' noise). In agent contexts (AGENT_ENV set, detected via agentx.IsAgentContext), the command now defaults to JSON carrying title, summary, entry_count, status, hydration_status, stop_reason, has_raw_data, and a top-level guidance string pointing agents at ox session view and ox session download when hydration is needed. Humans still get the table. --json=false is the escape hatch to force text inside an agent.
key_actions: Added Title field to session.SessionInfo, populated from lfs.SessionMeta.Title
Wired meta.json title into the text-table second line with smart summary fallback
Filtered fallback to skip markdown headings, bullets, and 'Summary generation failed' text
Detected agent context via agentx.IsAgentContext and defaulted to JSON output there
Added top-level guidance string pointing agents at ox session view / download
Included hydration_status so agents know when to download before viewing
Added --json=false escape hatch for forcing text inside an agent
Ran make install to deploy the updated binary
